LanguageData.setting_TrueGrowingTimeDesc: Displays the true amount of time the crop requires to grow
LanguageData.setting_DailyHarvestDesc: Displays the theoretical yield that the crop produces per day
LanguageData.setting_DailyCashDesc: Displays the theoretical silver that the crop produces per day
LanguageData.setting_DailyNaturalNutritionDesc: Displays the theoretical nutrition that the plant grows per day
LanguageData.setting_DailyHarvestedNutritionDesc: Displays the theoretical nutrition that the crop produces per day
LanguageData.setting_GrazingCapacityDesc: Displays the quantity of plants you'll need to sustain an animal through the plants natural growth
LanguageData.setting_HarvestedFeedCapacityDesc: Displays the quantity of crops you'll need to sustain an animal through the crops harvested nutrition
LanguageData.setting_ExpandedAnimalHyperlinksDesc: Expands the provided animal hyperlinks to include all animals in the game within a relative range (megafauna for thrumbos, large ranch-animals for cows, etc).\n\nThis includes modded animals.
LanguageData.setting_PawnCapacityDesc: Displays the quantity of crops needed to sustain one Pawn, with statistics on raw, cooked or paste efficiency.
LanguageData.TrueGrowingTimeDesc: The amount of time this plant actually takes to grow. Plants spend eleven hours of every day asleep, which the Growing Time figure does not factor in. This stat is a more accurate approximation of their growth time in nominal conditions (100% light, 100% fertility, perfect temperature)
LanguageData.HarvestPerDayDesc: The rough equivalent of how many items this plant produces per day.
LanguageData.PlantNutritionPerDayDesc: The rough equivalent of how much nutrition this plant grows per day.
LanguageData.NutritionPerDayDesc: The rough equivalent of how much nutrition this crop produces per day.
LanguageData.CashPerDayDesc: The rough equivalent of how much silver this crop produces per day.
LanguageData.PlantsPerAnimalDesc: The rough equivalent of how much of this plant you'll need to keep a specific animal alive indefinitely.\n\nDo note that animals can vary their nutrition consumption due to their lifestage and health, and that comparable animal species (for example, horses and donkeys) can still vary in large ways with their nutritional consumption, so always check their base nutrition consumption before planning out your zones.
LanguageData.CropsPerPawnDesc: The rough equivalent of how much of this crop you'll need to keep one pawn alive indefinitely.\n\nThis is assuming the pawn is a baseliner without any augmentations or hediffs that may affect their nutritional consumption.
